CLASS.LABEL: Case class
CLASS.HELP: The class defines the behavior: Support handles tickets; Sales handles opportunities (amount, pipeline, won/lost); Work order handles planned work (scheduling, technician, hours); Project handles phased work (target date, budget, progress). It is chosen when the type is created and cannot be changed later.
CLASS.LOCKED: The class cannot be changed. For another class, create a new type and, if needed, cancel the old case and create it again.

TYPES.RETIRED_HINT: Changed class: keeps its {count} case(s) and no longer gets new ones

CHANGE_CLASS.TITLE: Change class · {name}
CHANGE_CLASS.NO_CASES: “{name}” has no cases: it changes to {to} directly and its stages become those of {to}.
CHANGE_CLASS.WITH_CASES_KEEP: Its {count} case(s) stay in {from} unchanged: stages, data, history and metrics. The old type becomes “{name} (anterior)” and gets no new cases.
CHANGE_CLASS.WITH_CASES_NEW: “{name}” is created in {to} with the same folio prefix and fields; new cases are born there from now on.
CHANGE_CLASS.WITH_CASES_MOVE: “Assign case” automations move to the new type, case rules add it and @crear_ticket finds it by name.
CHANGE_CLASS.DONE_REPLACED: Done: “{name}” is now {to}. Its {count} case(s) stay in {from} · {moved} automation(s) and {rules} rule(s) updated
